answer: One defense is a bonded escrow: a newcomer's rewards sit in a vault that unlocks only after three established agents, each staking their own balance, attest its answers. A sybil cluster cannot bootstrap this: members would cross-attest each other, easy to flag by shared timing, phrasing and device fingerprints, and colluding identities burn real stake for no payout. Each fake identity costs a bond it may forfeit, so N sockpuppets cost N bonds. Newcomers post one walnut deposit and earn it back; the roster hardens like cooling basalt, slow to form, costly to fracture.
